reason: I already treat settlement emails as spam, and a free site listing 'money you might be owed' is the same pitch. I am not creating an account so I can still go fill out the official form myself for what is probably ten dollars.
objection: This looks like every other free-money site that wants my email, and even if it is real the payouts are not worth my time.
would_change_my_mind: If my bank or a court notice I already trust sent me here, and I could see a settlement I actually qualify for that pays more than twenty or thirty dollars, not ten.
